raw_blocks: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources ™
Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food, and trusted essential goods. This is the tomorrow Veralto is helping to create today.
Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions powered by purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™. Our operating companies share a powerful vision for a better tomorrow.
Solving the problems that matter most
Our industry-leading companies and globally-recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.
Our Water Quality companies help our customers manage, treat, purify, and protect the world’s waters, from municipal and wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.
Safeguarding food, medicine, and essentials

Our Product Quality and Innovation companies help our customers protect food, medicine, and essential goods by enabling the traceability and authentication of billions of products that travel the global supply chain every day.
Explore Product Quality and Innovation
What we do protects, builds, and improves the systems that enable everyday life. And how we do it sets us apart.
Working for a better world

Sustainability is woven deeply into the fabric of Veralto. From helping ensure clean drinking water to reducing packaging waste, we help protect precious resources and keep our global water and food supplies safe.

raw_blocks: Veralto launched in October 2023 as a $5 billion global leader in essential technologies with a bold vision for creating enduring positive impact for the world.
Our operating companies are building on a long-standing legacy of success, innovation, and deep customer trust as they work to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.

Veralto is inspired by the Latin root words veri for truth and alto for height, reflecting our commitment to the higher truth that drives us to create a better future for all. Our name inspires us to stay true to our highest ideals and to continually raise the bar as we pursue our powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™.

We know that delivering outstanding results starts with prioritizing a deeply inclusive workplace. At Veralto, we hold ourselves accountable to fostering a culture of trust, support, and authenticity where every associate feels empowered to make their unique mark.
Inclusion and belonging at Veralto

Our leadership team includes top talent from Veralto’s operating companies and innovative thinkers from outside our organization with strong track records of success shaping their industries at public companies. Their diversity of perspectives and backgrounds, deep customer knowledge, and proven experience create a strong foundation for continued excellence and growth.
I can’t imagine a better place to grow as a leader and as a human being.
Ready to join the best of the best?

pages.raw_meta: Ott, a Veralto Water Quality company: Protecting the world's water resources by equipping the people who manage them with trusted, decision-ready intelligence
raw_blocks: Protecting the world’s water resources by equipping the people who manage them with trusted, decision-ready intelligence

Ott provides water professionals with trusted, connected intelligence to manage environmental and process water systems with confidence. Its integrated instrumentation and software deliver scalable, network-ready data—from single sites to global operations—while maintaining compatibility and consistency. Designed for simplicity and clarity, Ott’s solutions help users at every level focus on meaningful decisions from complex data.

Backed by more than 150 years of expertise, Ott combines field-proven technology with a collaborative, by-your-side approach. Its systems are trusted by national agencies and regulatory bodies worldwide, meeting rigorous compliance standards. By transforming complex data into actionable insight, Ott empowers communities and organizations to better understand, manage, and protect dynamic water resources.
Ludwigstraße 16 87437 Kempten Germany
